name: LAB-Bench
intro: LAB-Bench是一个用于评估AI系统在生物学研究中实际能力的大型基准测试。它包含2400多个多项选择题，涵盖了文献回顾、图表解读、数据库访问和DNA/蛋白质序列操作等任务。该基准旨在评估语言模型在科学研究工作流中的表现，并作为开发自动化研究系统的有用工具。
intro_en: LAB-Bench is a large benchmark designed to evaluate AI systems' practical capabilities in biological research. It includes over 2,400 multiple-choice questions covering tasks such as literature review, chart interpretation, database access, and DNA/protein sequence manipulation. The benchmark aims to assess language models' performance in scientific research workflows and serves as a useful tool for developing automated research systems.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2407.10362. LAB-Bench uses multiple dataset-creation strategies for biology research tasks. SeqQA and DbQA are largely generated programmatically for scalable sequence and database questions, while LitQA2, SuppQA, FigQA, TableQA, ProtocolQA, and CloningScenarios are manually authored by the authors and contracted biology experts. Model-generated prototype questions are used as inspiration in some categories, the benchmark forms over 2,400 multiple-choice QA pairs, human experts provide baseline performance with tool access but no AI tools, and models are scored mainly by accuracy/precision/coverage.
